title: Google offers nonprofits free AI courses and individual coaching
friendlyTitle: Nonprofits can get free AI training and help from Google
summary: Google.org has launched three free, nonprofit-specific online courses covering everyday AI use, fundraising, creativity and workflows. Eligible Google for Nonprofits organisations can also book no-cost one-to-one product coaching, alongside a new survey of AI adoption across more than 6,000 organisations.
friendlySummary: Google offers three free online AI courses for nonprofits, plus one-to-one coaching for eligible organisations.
whyItMatters: Training and implementation support are often bigger barriers than access to a chatbot. Nonprofit teams can use the resources to test administrative workflows without spending programme funds, while setting review and privacy rules before wider adoption.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Small nonprofit teams can learn practical ways to save time without paying for training. They should set privacy and checking rules before using AI widely.
